intro: Benin is a presidential republic, known for its peaceful move to democracy in 1990.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is directly elected; 2025 changes made the term seven years. Romuald Wadagni won the April 2026 election and took office in May. Critics say democracy has narrowed since 2016, and an attempted coup was put down in December 2025.

chapters.title: The north
text: Armed groups from the Sahel have attacked northern Benin in recent years.

keyTerms.meaning: A country with an elected head of state.
